questions.prompt: Which of these are capital cities?
questions.fact: Australia's capital is Canberra, Morocco's is Rabat, and Switzerland's is Bern.

questions.prompt: Which of these live in the ocean their whole lives?
questions.fact: Coral looks like a rock but is an animal, and it spends its whole life fixed to one spot.

questions.prompt: How many players are on the field for one football team?
questions.fact: Eleven, including the goalkeeper. It has been eleven since the rules were written down in 1863.

questions.prompt: How hot is the surface of the Sun, in degrees Celsius?
questions.fact: About 5,500 degrees at the surface, and around 15 million at the core.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a prime number?
questions.hint: Three of them divide neatly by 3.
questions.fact: A prime divides by nothing but itself and one. 29 is the only one here that manages it.

questions.prompt: Which artist cut off part of his own ear?
questions.hint: He painted a night sky full of swirling stars.
questions.fact: He painted himself afterwards with the bandage on, and sold almost nothing in his lifetime.
